hero.title: Expert Care for Mind, Brain & Child Development
hero.sub: Multidisciplinary Healthcare Services Under One Roof. V-KARE brings professional psychiatry, child orthopedics, audiology, and therapy support directly to Tumkur.

quickActions.inClinicDesc: Visit V-KARE Clinic in Tumkur for face-to-face diagnostics, physical rehabilitation, and consultations.
quickActions.videoDesc: Consult with our board-certified psychiatrists, clinical psychologists, and therapists from home.

services.title: Our Services
services.sub: Explore our expert departments designed for mental wellness, physical healing, and communication skills.
services.psychDesc: We provide comprehensive assessment and evidence-based clinical support for adults and children facing psychological, behavioural, and emotional challenges.
services.orthoDesc: Specialized diagnostics and surgical solutions for congenital deformities, bone injuries, and neuromuscular motor conditions in children.
services.speechDesc: Advanced evaluation of hearing capacity, speech correction, feeding difficulties, and specialized school-based therapy support.

why.title: Why Choose V-KARE?
why.sub: We blend high-quality evidence-based clinical expertise with emotional and physical rehabilitation.
why.card1Text: All psychiatric therapies, pediatric surgeries, and audiology services are backed by proven clinical standards.
why.card2Text: Psychiatrists, Pediatric Orthopedicians, Speech Therapists, and Psychologists collaborating under one roof.
why.card3Text: Your privacy is our priority. We maintain strict ethical standards for child and adult counselling.
why.card4Text: Conveniently located in Siddaganga Extension, Tumkur, offering world-class care locally.

specialists.title: Licensed Experts & Specialists
specialists.sub: Consult with our team of board-certified, licensed clinicians dedicated to your holistic recovery.

appointment.title: Online Appointment Booking
appointment.sub: Submit your preferred slot. Our desk will contact you via Phone/WhatsApp to confirm.
appointment.name: Patient Name
appointment.step1Desc: Choose from Psychiatry, Pediatric Orthopedics, or Speech Pathologies depending on treatment required.
appointment.step2Desc: Choose a convenient date and time range for your consultation slot.
appointment.step3Desc: Select In-Clinic visit or secure encrypted Video Consultation.
appointment.step4Desc: Get instant confirmation, real-time portal notifications, and WhatsApp/Email status updates.

contact.title: Contact & Location
contact.sub: Visit us at Tumkur or reach out directly for immediate support.
contact.addressText: 3rd Cross, Jain Bhavana Road, Siddaganga Extension, Tumkur, Karnataka – 572102

footer.about: V-KARE Mind & Brain Clinic is Tumkur's leading multidisciplinary healthcare clinic, providing dedicated services in Psychiatry, Child Orthopedics, Speech Pathology, and Counseling.
